entities.name: Razor Fields
entities.description: Metallic plains on Mirrodin named for the razorgrass, home to the Auriok and the leonin.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane where the Razor Fields lie.

entities.name: Auriok
entities.description: Nomadic people who wandered the Razor Fields, trading with those they met.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: A people who established dominance over the Razor Fields, with Taj-Nar as capital.

entities.name: Taj-Nar
entities.description: The largest leonin den, at the center of the Fields, chosen as leonin capital.

entities.name: Bladehold
entities.description: The largest Auriok settlement, built on a mesa above tall razorgrass.

entities.name: Ria Ivor
entities.description: Rescued Bladehold during the Mirran-Phyrexian War before her compleation.

entities.name: Lowlight
entities.description: An encampment of surviving leonin abunas led by Kemba near the Cave of Light.

entities.name: Kemba
entities.description: Leader of the leonin abunas at Lowlight.

entities.name: Ten Shields
entities.description: A trade settlement used by both Auriok and leonin.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who conquered and compleated Mirrodin.

entities.name: Fair Basilica
entities.description: The luminous white-aligned terrain that replaced the Mirrodin plains, the seventh layer of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mirrex
entities.description: The wasteland the former surface of Mirrodin became.

events.summary: The leonin establish dominance over the Razor Fields and make Taj-Nar their capital.
events.quote: it was chosen as the leonin capital

events.summary: After the compleation of Mirrodin, its surface becomes the Mirrex wasteland and the Fair Basilica replaces the metallic plains.
events.quote: the former surface was rendered a wasteland known as the Mirrex

events.summary: Ria Ivor rescues Bladehold during the Mirran-Phyrexian War.
events.quote: Rescued by Ria Ivor during the Mirran-Phyrexian War before her compleation

relations.note: The encampment was formed by leonin abunas led by Kemba.
relations.quote: surviving leonin abunas led by Kemba
the largest leonin den located in the Fields' center
